name: AppSignal Free
free_limit: Ongoing Free: 30,000 app requests/month, 1 GB logging and 5-day retention
watch_out: Existing Free users' grandfathered 50,000 requests/month allowance ends on October 31, 2026; afterward the Free tier is 30,000 requests/month. Crossing the request or logging limit locks the UI/API and disables notifications rather than generating overage invoices. A limited-term paid upgrade discount is not an ongoing free allowance.
